about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: No Never-list breaches in the captions, but 2026-11-24-reactive1 falls short of the premium visual standard and is held; only that post had images to review.
points: 2026-11-24-reactive1 (card): 'Compared across multiple UK retailers' sits almost on top of the GOLFPRICEAI.COM wordmark with no breathing room, so the bottom block is cramped. Fix: add clear space between the URL and the retailers line, or move that line up under 'Driver. Irons. Putter. Wedges.'.

2026-11-24-reactive1 (card and thumbnail): the top third is empty starfield and the whole lower half is a grid with no product or bag, so the layout is bottom-heavy and unbalanced. Fix: add a sharp, large bag or club image, or move the title block up and balance the space.

2026-11-24-reactive1 (thumbnail): only 4 words are big, with 'Driver. Irons. Putter. Wedges.' and the tagline too small at phone-grid size, and no product is visible. Fix: show the bag or a club large, and keep the big words ('ASSEMBLE THE BAG') in the middle 4:5. Black and green does match Doomsday, which is good. The card and thumbnail carry the same colours.
2026-11-24-reactive1 (video): the mp4 frames could not be extracted (no ffmpeg available), so the pace, hook in the first second and match to the thumbnail are unchecked. Please check them by eye.

Only 2026-11-24-reactive1 had images in /tmp/review-images. The other 14 posts' cards, thumbnails and video frames were not supplied, so their visuals are unreviewed. Re-run with their images before they go out.

2026-11-25-tiein2: the YouTube title is cut mid-word ('Over 300 golf mode') and starts 'Ad Black Friday...' without the '#'. Fix: write a short title under 100 characters, e.g. 'Black Friday week: golf deals genuinely cheaper than October'.

2026-11-25-tiein2: the 'over 300 models' and '£524 on the Mizuno Pro S-4 Irons' figures could not be matched in the data files I checked. Confirm they come from the site's price-history before it posts.

2026-11-27-moment and 2026-11-30-mon: they say 'across multiple UK retailers', but many catalogue items show retailerCount 1. Confirm the featured product really has more than one retailer, or reword.

2026-11-26-thu: the Callaway Apex Ai200 £919 / '81 days' claim could not be verified from the lite catalogue, where the cheapest listed variant is £1,029. Check that the price history supports it and that the right variant is shown.

2026-11-28-sat: the caption asks 'over or under £860?' and the cover says 'Higher or lower?'. That is fine as it doesn't give away the answer, but check that the on-screen price isn't shown in the opening frames.
